system.description: Starting at 6th level, you learn to infuse a surge of chakra into your Battle Medic state. As part of entering your Battle Medic state, you can invoke this Domain ability, spending 1 Charge. When you do, you gain the Strength of 100 enhancements for the duration of this state. If an effect doesn’t appear in the enhancement, then default to the original effects of the Battle Medic state.
